title: Concept Vector Robustness to Character-Level Perturbations

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: character-level evasion is a well-known attack on content moderation. Determining whether concept probes are robust or vulnerable to these perturbations directly informs whether additional defenses are needed for deployed steering systems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Character-level perturbations (leetspeak, homoglyphs, spacing) are trivial to implement. Running perturbed prompts through concept probes and measuring evasion rate is straightforward. Medium compute is more than sufficient. Very accessible for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Extremely tightly scoped: apply a set of perturbation types to known harmful prompts, run through concept probes, measure detection rate. Single experiment with a clear table of evasion rates. Completable well within 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
